title: Monad Metropolis Hackathon
description: Metropolis is Monad's six-week online global hackathon (1 Sep to 13 Oct) to build the next generation of startups on Monad. Four tracks, $250,000+ in prizes, sponsor bounties, and a residency invite for top teams. Open to everyone, solo or teams, crypto-native or not.
reward: $250,000+ prize pool: $30,000 per track (split evenly between 3 teams), $25,000 grand champion, plus sponsor prizes and bounties
summary: $250,000+ prize pool · closes Oct 13, 11:59 PM ET
ideas: A payments app with per-second subscriptions on Monad
A passkey-native account using WebAuthn on Monad
An onchain order book with no offchain matching engine
setup: log in to hackathon.monad.xyz (GitHub, Google, or Discord)
rules: Submissions open on the platform on 2 Oct and close 13 Oct 2026 at 23:59 ET (per the application platform, hackathon.monad.xyz).
The project must be a product built on Monad.
Existing projects are allowed only if the work you submit is new: what you show on 13 Oct should have been built during the six weeks.
Open sourcing is encouraged but not required. Judges need to be able to verify what you built during the six weeks.
Teams and solo builders are both welcome. No prior onchain experience or fundraising needed.
Online and open globally. Any eligibility restrictions are listed in the official rules on the application platform.
You choose one track when you apply. Projects are judged per track from 14 to 27 Oct; winners are announced on 3 Nov.
Top teams get ecosystem support and an invite to a residency program.
